{{Quote|This popular sandwich boasts sliced Manpha-fowl, nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato. Served on toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Shawda Clubb sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Nuna bacon''' was a type of [[Bacon/Legends|bacon]] that shared its name<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> with the [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Wildlife Field Guide" /> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used nuna bacon at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The diner offered the bacon as a breakfast side dish, costing 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for four pieces, or with [[Anoat oat]]s as part of a [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate special]] for 4.7 credits. The diner also sold [[Shawda Clubb sandwich]]es and [[Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich]]es both made with nuna bacon.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nuna bacon was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
